data.narrative:
Stark Defence is a Series C-stage defense & security company seeking valuation anchoring against a peer set of 15 same-sector and adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Castelion, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

The peer-median method is the sole applicable triangulation approach. Stage-progression analysis was excluded because the stated current valuation of $4.0B implies a 68x return multiple relative to $100M total raised—a signal of data integrity issues that render the method untrustworthy. Peer-median valuation across the 15-company cohort yields $2.2B, with a range spanning $300M (floor) to $13.0B (ceiling, Castelion at Series C). Sampled peers include Castelion at $13.0B (Series C), Saronic at $9.2B (Series D), and Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), anchoring the distribution.

This single-method analysis supports a valuation range of $1.9B to $2.5B, centered on the peer median of $2.2B. The wide peer dispersion ($300M–$13.0B) reflects stage heterogeneity and heterogeneous risk profiles within defense & security. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, technology differentiation, and customer concentration relative to the peer cohort. Validation against public market multiples and revenue-based metrics would strengthen confidence in this range.
